name: Ring of Elemental Command (Fire)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dominate an Fire Elemental
powers.text: 2 charges: cast Dominate Monster (save DC 18) on an Fire Elemental.

summary: Command over Fire elementals, Resistance to Fire damage, and its element's spells (save DC 18).
text: This ring is linked to the Elemental Plane of Fire. While wearing it, you have Advantage on attack rolls against Fire Elementals, and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. The ring has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend 2 of them to cast Dominate Monster (save DC 18) on an Fire Elemental. You also have Resistance to Fire damage. You know Ignan. You can cast its spells from it, spending the charges listed: Burning Hands (1), Fireball (2), Wall Of Fire (3), Fire Storm (4).
